# Test files

`speech.wav`, `enroll.wav` and the voices of `mix.wav` are clips of [Common Voice](https://commonvoice.mozilla.org) (French test set), released under CC0. `mix.wav` adds another Common Voice voice and generated pink noise.

`*.f32` are little-endian float32 outputs of the Alkove engine built natively, on the models: the SDK's wasm must give the same bits.
